svg.title: Aliasing at 10 Hz sampling
svg.desc: Top: an 8 hertz sine and an inverted 2 hertz sine pass through the same eleven samples taken every 0.1 seconds. Bottom: a 10 hertz sine sampled once per cycle is zero at every sample, like a constant signal.
svg.text: Sampled every 0.1 s (10 Hz), the controller receives only the dots
